funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support of up to £6,000 for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles related to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (higher tiers for postdoctoral level); open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or about to start a Master's or Doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides a fixed £5,000 to support students beginning or continuing their postgraduate studies in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching 18th‑19th century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Provides £2,000 to support travel for research on historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a Master's degree at a UK institution, starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a Master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc) that brings new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a Doctorate at a UK institution, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants eligible (fees may differ).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a doctoral programme, covering tuition and living costs, to expand understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level or with equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree; pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised experts; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome for advanced research on British‑Italian topics, including board, accommodation and honorarium.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) – Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of ERBA (Emerging Researchers in British Art); open to members internationally, but travel funded for research trips related to British art.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £250 to cover transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses for a research travel trip.
